What we offer
- Salary of € 15,55 per hour!
- Breaks are paid!
- Travel allowance and holiday pay!

- Obtain certificates for EPT and reach truck.

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you, as a logistics employee, meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch or English.
- You have your own transportation.
- You are physically able to lift boxes up to 20 kilos if necessary.
- You are available within a week.

In this beautiful, new building, you'll get even more exercise than you already did. As a packer at DSV, you're constantly on the go. You won't find this opportunity to stay active anywhere else. You'll work with all kinds of products, from toy houses to electronic items. After a few hours of hard work, DSV immediately rewards you with paid breaks! Super chill, right?
After your break, you can work hard again for a few hours with your amazing colleagues. One team, one task! You feel accomplished and have received your salary, which you'll see in your account within a week. What more could you ask for? Chill out at home. Tomorrow is another day at your fantastic job as a logistics employee!

- Working days from Monday to Friday.
- Working hours from 08:30-17:00.

 Labeling operator 
 - € 2629 - Leiden - 40 uur - Detacheren - Vmbo 
Start your career as a labeling operator in Leiden. Work full-time in a day shift from 08.00 till 16.30 and make an impact in healthcare. 
 Over het werk 
As a labeling operator, you are an essential part of the logistics process for pharmaceuticals. You work a full-time schedule in a fixed day shift from 08.00 till 16.30, guaranteeing regularity and work-life balance. This is a stable position with prospects for long-term employment and opportunities for growth within the organization. Internal training is available to help you develop your skills further. You work closely with colleagues and an advanced robot in an innovative setting. 
You start your working day by checking the robot that collects the correct medication for patients. Once the robot has done its job, you take the box with medicines, carefully label it with the patient's name, and then put it in a bag. The work consists of the same steps each time: pick, label, bag. You perform your tasks with great precision and understand the importance of privacy and accuracy when handling personal data. 
Are you a team player who enjoys structure and precision? 
 Wat wij bieden 
 - Salary of € 15.11 per hour - Full-time job: 40 hours per week - Fixed day shift from 08.00 till 16.30 - Opportunities for personal development and training - Work in a committed and professional environment Wat wij vragen 
 - At least vmbo (pre-vocational secondary education) working and thinking level - 1 to 2 years of work experience, preferably in logistics - You have a good command of the English language in speaking - You are accurate and careful with personal data - You live a maximum of 20 km from Leiden

Conventional Lathe Operator

Conventional turning outdated? Not in our work!
Alongside CNC machining, conventional techniques continue to offer plenty of challenges.

You will perform turning operations on components up to Ø1,500 x 8,000 mm, weights up to 8,000 kg. Most parts are one-offs, requiring precise work, patience, and perseverance. 
First time right is more important than speed.
In addition to conventional turning, knowledge of 3-axis CNC milling is preferred. 
If you don’t have this yet, no problem! You are eager to learn and willing to develop these skills.

We understand that it can take 1 to 2 years for a new colleague to reach the desired level in our field. 

We start with a one-year contract, but aim to convert it to a permanent position as soon as possible.
We work daytime shifts, and a 4-day workweek is available if you prefer.

Requirements 
•    At least a level 3 vocational education (MBO 3) or equivalent; a completed qualification is a plus but not required.
•    Hands-on experience in machining.
•    Practical, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.

Personal qualities
•    Patient and persistent, with a strong work ethic
•    Thinks before starting a task
•    Works in a structured and precise manner, with a clear understanding of the job at hand
•    Able to work independently, but also thrives in a team environment
•    Speaks English

- Compressor rotor
- Double-acting hydraulic cylinder
- Screw compressor housing
- Turbine shaft
- Drive roller
- Propeller shaft
